name: Torrechiva (Spain)
description: Blue field with white wavy stripes at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with a white tower flanked by a sword and a key.
history: Municipal flag of Torrechiva; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy stripes at the hoist and fly
tower with a sword and a key
